# Every constructor property of a UniFFI-generated Kotlin class whose type is
# (or contains) kotlin.String, kotlin.ByteArray, PlaintextBytes or
# PlaintextText, with its exact generated type. check_generated_plaintext.py
# fails the bridge build when the generated Kotlin differs from this list.
#
# A  message plaintext: must be PlaintextBytes/PlaintextText (toString redacted)
# C  ciphertext / wire bytes
# D  ids and public metadata (keys, fingerprints, contact names, notes)
# F  Rust error and status text, not application content
#
# Owner.field<TAB>type<TAB>class
ChatEntry.appId	kotlin.ByteArray	D
ChatEntry.text	PlaintextText	A
Conversation.fingerprint	kotlin.String	D
Conversation.name	kotlin.String	D
Conversation.note	kotlin.String	F
Conversation.peer	kotlin.ByteArray	D
CoreException.Crypto.msg	kotlin.String	F
CoreException.Handshake.msg	kotlin.String	F
CoreException.InvalidArgument.msg	kotlin.String	F
CoreException.InvalidContactCard.msg	kotlin.String	F
CoreException.InvalidHandshake.msg	kotlin.String	F
CoreException.InvalidKey.msg	kotlin.String	F
CoreException.InvalidPrekeyBundle.msg	kotlin.String	F
CoreException.InvalidSessionState.msg	kotlin.String	F
CoreException.Network.msg	kotlin.String	F
CoreException.Storage.msg	kotlin.String	F
IncomingMessage.messageId	kotlin.ByteArray	D
IncomingMessage.plaintext	PlaintextBytes	A
OutgoingMessage.clientMessageId	kotlin.ByteArray	D
OutgoingMessage.messageId	kotlin.ByteArray	D
OutgoingMessage.wire	kotlin.ByteArray	C
ReceiveResult.Duplicate.messageId	kotlin.ByteArray	D
ReceivedText.messageId	kotlin.ByteArray	D
ReceivedText.text	PlaintextBytes	A
SendResult.Abandoned.messageId	kotlin.ByteArray	D
SendResult.AlreadyAcknowledged.messageId	kotlin.ByteArray	D
SentText.messageId	kotlin.ByteArray	D
SyncReport.errors	List<kotlin.String>	F
